summary: Lease-derived sandbox profile hardening is implemented. SandboxProfile serialization now projects namespace, cgroup, seccomp, filesystem, Landlock, and network allowlist metadata. security_execution::sandbox_profile adds a LeaseSandboxProfileCompiler that accepts CapabilityLease as authority, ignores planner-provided weakening hints, classifies profile classes, fails closed for unsupported risk classes, and returns auditable profile bindings for EffectEnvelope integration.

acceptance.criterion: Read-only leases compile to profiles with no persistent write access.
acceptance.evidence: security_execution::sandbox_profile::tests::read_only_lease_compiles_without_persistent_write_access confirms persistent_write_allowed=false and planner writable host paths are ignored.

acceptance.criterion: Planner output cannot add writable host paths or broaden network access.
acceptance.evidence: planner_network_hints_cannot_broaden_http_check_allowlist confirms http.check allowlist stays bound to the lease resource, while malicious planner network hints are ignored.

acceptance.criterion: Unsupported risk classes fail closed until explicitly implemented.
acceptance.evidence: unsupported_risk_classes_fail_closed checks write-with-diff, execute-with-confirmation, privileged, and never profile classes all return unsupported errors.

acceptance.criterion: Sandbox profile metadata appears in the EffectEnvelope.
acceptance.evidence: sandbox_profile_metadata_appears_in_effect_envelope serializes no_new_privs, seccomp, filesystem, cgroup, network allowlist, and Landlock metadata inside EffectEnvelope.

acceptance.criterion: Resource abuse fixtures still hit configured limits.
acceptance.evidence: resource_abuse_still_hits_configured_limits uses SandboxExecutor to deny process fanout beyond pids.max.

sandbox_profile_contract.planner_hints: recorded as ignored and never used as authority
